# ![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=github.com&sz=64)GitHub v3 REST API

github.com

GitHub's REST API for building integrations, retrieving data, and automating workflows on the GitHub platform (repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, etc.).

The GitHub v3 REST API API uses Bearer token authentication; has free pricing; offers a free tier (Unauthenticated requests allowed at 60 requests/hour; authenticated requests up to 5,000 requests/hour); rate limits: 60 req/hour unauthenticated; 5,000 req/hour authenticated (15,000 for GitHub Enterprise Cloud orgs); 1,000 req/hour per repo for GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions; secondary limits e.g. 100 concurrent requests. Verified 2026-07-12 with per-field source links.

Base URL

https://api.github.com

[docs.github.com ↗](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/authentication/authenticating-to-the-rest-api)

Auth

Bearer token

[docs.github.com ↗](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/authentication/authenticating-to-the-rest-api)

Free tier

Unauthenticated requests allowed at 60 requests/hour; authenticated requests up to 5,000 requests/hour

[docs.github.com ↗](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api)

Pricing model

free

[github.com ↗](https://github.com/pricing)

Pricing

The REST API is included with GitHub accounts; GitHub plans start at Free ($0/month), Team ($4/user/month), and Enterprise (from $21/user/month), but the API is not billed separately.

[github.com ↗](https://github.com/pricing)

Rate limits

60 req/hour unauthenticated; 5,000 req/hour authenticated (15,000 for GitHub Enterprise Cloud orgs); 1,000 req/hour per repo for GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions; secondary limits e.g. 100 concurrent requests

[docs.github.com ↗](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api)
